_ _ _ For Petitioner :
Mr. Manish Nigam, Advocate.

For Respondent/State : Mr. Aman Kesharwani, Panel Lawyer.
________________________________________________________

Hon'ble Shri
Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal, Judge Cav Judgment 21.07.2023

1 . The petitioner by this transfer petition under Section 407 of the Cr.P.C read with Section 482 of
the Cr.P.C pending before the Juvenile Justice Board, Kondagao, in Case No. 45 of 2021 parties
being (State of C.G. v/s S, Juvenile in Conflict with Law) for commission of offence under section
363, 366, 376 (2)(n) of Ipc, Section 6 of Pocso Act, Section 3 (2) (v-a) of Sc-St Prevention of
Atrocities Actand Section 4/141 of Motor Vehicle Act has prayed for transfer of case to some other
Juvenile Justice Board of adjoining district.
2.  The petitioner has prayed for direction to transfer the case which is pending before the Juvenile Justice Board, Kondagaon.

3. Facts of the case when the Chief Judicial Magistrate of the District itself is a prosecution witness and father of the prosecutrix, the petitioner has a strong belief that he may not get the equal treatment with the opposite party and there is no likelihood of fair and impartial trial before the Juvenile Justice Board, Kondagaon.

S vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/191925724/
1

4. Learned counsel for the State submits that the petitioner has filed the petition on 03.02.2022, in present who is posted as a Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kondagaon has not been clarified.
5.
As per the information in the High Court of Chhattisgarh site, father of the victim at present is not posted in District - Kondagaon and therefore, the matter is not liable to be kept pending.
6. Accordingly, the present petition is disposed of.

Sd/-
